newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy suspends Enel rate cut till April.
newsitem.headline: Italy suspends Enel rate cut till April.

text.p: An Italian administrative court on Friday suspended recently-introduced cuts in electricity tariffs charged by state-owned utility Enel until April 4.
The decision, by the Council of State, overrides cuts introduced on February 13 in the wake of another court ruling outlawing rate rises imposed in 1993.
"From this evening the old tariffs will be reintroduced, complete with the increases decided in 1993, until April 4 when the matter will be decided," one electricity source said.
Some analysts said the tariff cuts had contributed to a fall in February inflation.
Preliminary inflation data released on Thursday pointed to a year-on-year inflation rate of 2.3 percent and a monthly rate of 0.0 percent.
Officials at national statistics office Istat were not immediately available for comment on the impact of Friday's court decision.
However Ilaria Fornari, economist with bank JP Morgan in Milan, said the tariff cut had contributed to a 0.14 percentage point fall in the year-on-year inflation rate this month.
Taken out of the equation, she said preliminary data would have shown inflation at some 2.4 percent year-on-year in February against a predicted 2.2 to 2.3 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
